description:
Chess a Day is a calm chess app. Play one good game against the computer, keep a gentle streak, then put the phone down.

PLAY THE COMPUTER
Stockfish 17 plays at five levels, from Easy, where it misses a lot, to Master, where it shows no mercy. Each level has its own colour, and the computer takes a moment to think, so games feel like a person across the table. Play with or without a clock.

FREE PLAY
Two people, one phone. Turn the board after each move or keep it still.

PLAY FRIENDS ONLINE
Invite a friend through Game Center and take turns at your own pace. Games waiting on you show first, and each player has 24 hours per turn.

LEARN OPENINGS
Four courses taught one move at a time: the London System and the Italian Game as White, the Sicilian Dragon and the Caro-Kann Defence as Black. Find each move, ask for a hint when you need one, then practise for three stars. Courses are lichess studies, shared by their authors.

QUIET BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Your games stay on your iPhone.
• A day strip and stats for wins, draws and losses at every level.
• One daily reminder, only if you want it.
• Board themes and three piece sets.
• VoiceOver labels every square, Reduce Motion turns slides into fades, and text follows your size.

Chess a Day is free software under the GPLv3.
promotionalText: Play the computer at five levels, a friend on one phone or online, and learn four openings one move at a time. No account, no ads.
